title: Resource metadata
description: The metadata every resource carries, whatever its kind. Directory-shaped kinds (skills, agents) keep it in meta.yaml; single-file kinds (MCP servers, workflows, knowledge bases) keep it under the "meta" key of their file. Unknown fields are allowed: a field starting with "x-" is yours to use, any other unknown field is reported as a possible typo but does not block anything.

summary.description: One sentence for people. A skill without one shows the description from its SKILL.md.

stages.description: Identifiers of the delivery stages this resource belongs to. May be left out for resources that do not belong to a stage.

when.description: The situation this resource is for. Recommendations match a task against it on the person's own computer.

try.description: A sentence a person can send to their AI tool as it is to see the resource work.

secrets.description: Names of the personal secrets this resource needs. Each must be defined in rigdepot.yaml. Secrets an MCP server refers to as ${secret:NAME} count without being listed here.

maintainers.description: Account names of the people who maintain this resource.

i18n.description: Name and descriptions in other languages, keyed by BCP 47 language tag. Only what people read is translated; what an AI reads, such as SKILL.md, exists once.

slug.description: Lower-case letters and digits in groups joined by single hyphens.

code.description: The identifier of a resource: its directory name, or its file name without the extension. 2 to 48 characters, unique in the repository across all kinds.

stageId.description: The identifier of a delivery stage. The default stages are requirement, architecture, design, develop, test, scm, release and ops; rigdepot.yaml can define others.

scope.description: Who the resource is for: "org" for the whole organisation, or the code of a product. A suggestion: once an administrator changes it on the server, the server's value wins.

policy.description: How the resource reaches the people in its scope: "required" is installed for everyone and cannot be turned off, "recommended" is installed unless a person turns it off, "optional" is installed only for people who turn it on. A suggestion, like scope.

audience.description: "rd" for engineering work, "mgmt" for the collaboration work around it.

secretName.description: The name of a personal secret: an upper-case letter followed by 1 to 63 upper-case letters, digits and underscores.

locale.description: A BCP 47 language tag, such as "en" or "zh-CN".

text.description: The fields people read, in one language. A field left out is shown untranslated.
